headline: Clean: the Platinum Rewards Card has the highest cash back, and its fee after the monthly-spend rebate ($50) fits the customer's $100 budget.
solution_check: Platinum: 'You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases' (platinum_002), annual fee $200 (platinum_001), '$150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00' (platinum_007), so $200 - $150 = $50 effective with her $50,000/month spend. The first-year waiver promo ran 2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31 (platinum_009), so it is expired on 2025-11-14 and does not block the rebate. Gold needs Rho-Bank+ (she has none) and Diamond Elite (5%) is lower and invitation-only. Gold application (Platinum Rewards Card, Sera Chen, 250000, false) matches; omitting rho_bank_subscription gives the same hash (default False).
prior_note: Prior verdict was None; v1.0.1 fixed the platinum_002 title from 'Earning 4% Cash Back' to 'Earning 10% Cash Back' (#388), removing the one inconsistency that could have confused the rate comparison.
notes: Rebate eligibility requires meeting the threshold in every monthly window (platinum_010); the customer's $50,000/month spend satisfies it. Credit scores are still written as dollar amounts in the card docs (e.g. gold_001 'Minimum credit score required: $720', bronze_001 '$640', silver_001 '$680', platinum_001 '$750'); v1.0.1 removed the '$105 days'/'$135 days' corruptions but not these. Reporting rule used across this batch: the corruption is an issue (Minor) only where the credit score decides the task; otherwise it is a note. Grading model checked against snapshot fc0055d (tag v1.0.1): EnvironmentEvaluator replays gold on a fresh env and compares get_db_hash/get_user_db_hash (both hash the one shared TransactionalDB); _derive_read_log_allowlist collects agent_tool_name from gold call_discoverable_agent_tool actions; call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool parse JSON with parse_int=float; apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float itself; Action.compare_with_tool_call matches by name plus compare_args (all agent-passed args when compare_args is None; always true when compare_args is []); get_now() is fixed at 2025-11-14 03:40:00 and get_current_time returns 'The current time is 2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST.'. Nuance: 'writes are logged even when the tool returns an error string' is only partly true. Many write paths return before touching the DB (apply_for_credit_card with an invalid card_type, call_discoverable_agent_tool on an unknown/not-unlocked tool or bad JSON, user discoverable tools not yet given).
